prompt: For the entity with the tightest position, list queued payments due in the next funding window.

results.text: EMEA Funding Ltd. has the tightest position. It has 6 queued payments due in the next funding window totalling USD 14.8 million.

sql.command: SELECT queued_payment_id, amount_usd, due_at FROM aa_funding_window WHERE entity_id = 'ENT-EMEA' ORDER BY minutes_until_due ASC
